source:
# Port of lib/pubid/jis/parser.rb — JIS identifiers with the Japanese
# full-width separator tolerance (ｰ 　 ： （）), TR/TS prefixes, parts,
# reaffirmed years, (E)/(J) language codes, 規格群 all-parts, AMD/EXPL/
# CORR supplements, and the SYMBOL clause. WES (Japan Welding Engineering
# Society) ids share the JIS tail but carry no series letter or JIS prefix.
# A WES id can carry a TR/TS type after the root (`WES TR 2032:2024`) and
# a language before the year (`WES 1112(E):2022`, bound as wes_language).

grammar PubidJis version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  dash = ("-" / "ｰ") as dash
  space = (" " / "　")
  colon = (":" / "：")
  type_prefix = ("TR" / "TS") as type (space / slash)
  series = %x41-5A as series
  number = (1*digit) as number
  part = dash (1*digit) as part
  parts = (*part) as parts
  year = colon (1*digit) as year [reaffirmed_rule]
  language = ("(" / "（") ("E" / "J") as language (")" / "）")
  all_parts = (("（" "規格群" "）") / ("(" "規格群" ")")) as all_parts
  amendment = {
    slash ("AMENDMENT" / "AMD") as amd_type
    space
    (1*digit) as amd_number
    colon (1*digit) as amd_year
    [("R" (*"R")) as amd_reaffirmed]
  }
  explanation = {
    slash ("EXPLANATION" / "EXPL") as expl_type
    ([space (1*digit) as expl_number])
  }
  corrigendum = {
    slash ("CORRIGENDUM" / "CORR") as corr_type
    space
    (1*digit) as corr_number
    colon (1*digit) as corr_year
    [("R" (*"R")) as corr_reaffirmed]
  }
  supplement = {
    (amendment as amendment)
    / (explanation as explanation)
    / (corrigendum as corrigendum)
  }
  symbol_value_char = %x01-09 / %x0B-10FFFF
  symbol_clause = {
    space "SYMBOL" as symbol_present
    ([space (1*symbol_value_char) as symbol_value])
  }
  wes_identifier = {
    "WES" as wes
    space
    [("TR" / "TS") as wes_type space]
    number
    parts
    [("(" / "（") ("E" / "J") as wes_language (")" / "）") &colon]
    [year]
    [language]
    [all_parts]
    [supplement]
    [symbol_clause]
  }
  jis_identifier = {
    ["JIS" [(space / slash)]]
    [type_prefix]
    [space]
    series
    [space]
    number
    parts
    [year]
    [language]
    [all_parts]
    [supplement]
    [symbol_clause]
  }
  identifier = wes_identifier / jis_identifier
  upper = %x41-5A
  digit = %x30-39
  slash = "/"
  reaffirmed_rule = ("R" (*"R")) as reaffirmed
  entry identifier: identifier

  # Typed model bindings: bound captures land on the consumer
  # builder's fields of the same name; repeated parts collect under
  # parts[].part.
  bindings identifier {
    wes -> wes (string)
    wes_type -> wes_type (string)
    wes_language -> wes_language (string)
    type -> type (string)
    series -> series (string)
    number -> number (string)
    part -> parts[].part (string)
    year -> year (string)
    reaffirmed -> reaffirmed (string)
    language -> language (string)
    all_parts -> all_parts (string)
    amd_type -> amd_type (string)
    amd_number -> amd_number (string)
    amd_year -> amd_year (string)
    amd_reaffirmed -> amd_reaffirmed (string)
    expl_type -> expl_type (string)
    expl_number -> expl_number (string)
    corr_type -> corr_type (string)
    corr_number -> corr_number (string)
    corr_year -> corr_year (string)
    corr_reaffirmed -> corr_reaffirmed (string)
    symbol_present -> symbol_present (string)
    symbol_value -> symbol_value (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "JIS B 0001"
    accept "JIS X 0208:1997"
    accept "WES 7700-1:2019"
    accept "WES 7301:2020R"
    reject "JIS WES 7700"
    reject "WES X 7700"
    reject "nonsense"
    example "WES 7700-1:2019" { wes: "WES", number: "7700", year: "2019" }
    example "WES 7301:2020R" { wes: "WES", number: "7301", year: "2020", reaffirmed: "R" }
    example "JIS X 0208:1997" { series: "X", number: "0208", year: "1997" }
    example "WES 7700:2019/AMD 1:2020R" { wes: "WES", number: "7700", amd_type: "AMD", amd_number: "1", amd_year: "2020", amd_reaffirmed: "R" }
    example "JIS X 0208:1997R" { series: "X", year: "1997", reaffirmed: "R" }
    example "JIS X 0208:1997RR" { series: "X", year: "1997", reaffirmed: "RR" }
    example "WES 1112(E):2022" { wes: "WES", number: "1112", wes_language: "E", year: "2022" }
    example "WES TR 2032:2024" { wes: "WES", wes_type: "TR", number: "2032", year: "2024" }
    example "WES TS 2816(E):2015" { wes: "WES", wes_type: "TS", number: "2816", wes_language: "E", year: "2015" }
    example "WES TS 2816:2015" { wes: "WES", wes_type: "TS", number: "2816", year: "2015" }
    example "WES 3003(E):1995/AMENDMENT 1:2025" { wes_language: "E", year: "1995", amd_type: "AMENDMENT", amd_number: "1", amd_year: "2025" }
    example "WES 1112:2022(E)" { language: "E", year: "2022" }
    example "WES 1112(E)" { wes: "WES", number: "1112", language: "E" }
    example "JIS A 0001:1999/AMD 1:2000" { series: "A", number: "0001", year: "1999", amd_type: "AMD", amd_number: "1", amd_year: "2000" }
    example "JIS B 3700-11:1996/CORRIGENDUM 1:2002" { series: "B", number: "3700", year: "1996", corr_type: "CORRIGENDUM", corr_number: "1", corr_year: "2002" }
    reject "JIS X 0208(E):1997"
    reject "TR WES 2032"
    reject "JIS TR WES 2032"
    reject "WES TX 2032:2024"
    reject "WES TR X 2032"
    example "WES　TR　2032：2024" { wes: "WES", wes_type: "TR", number: "2032", year: "2024" }
    example "WES 1112（E）：2022" { wes: "WES", number: "1112", wes_language: "E", year: "2022" }
  }
}
